fact: The party reached a door leading into a temple chamber identified as the Oozing Temple Fountain Room 034.06.
source_quote: the party reached a door leading into a temple chamber
subject: Oozing Temple Fountain Room 034.06

fact: Inside the chamber stands a stone fountain with a raised edge and a basin of shallow, brackish water.
source_quote: Inside stood a stone fountain filled with shallow, brackish water
subject: Stone Fountain

fact: The rubble of a broken statue lies atop a central pedestal, with only a pair of clawed stone feet still recognizable.
source_quote: The rubble of a broken statue lay atop a central pedestal, with only a pair of clawed stone feet still recognizable
subject: Broken Statue

fact: Seven niches line the walls of the fountain chamber.
source_quote: Seven niches lined the walls
subject: Seven Niches

fact: One niche admits water through a crack.
source_quote: one admitted water through a crack
subject: Water Seep Niche

fact: The two niches flanking the water seep niche are empty.
source_quote: the two beside it were empty
subject: Empty Niches

fact: Four niches contain strange, formless sculptures.
source_quote: four contained strange, formless sculptures
subject: Formless Sculptures

fact: Skeletons lie in the chamber, prompting the party to consider removing their weapons.
source_quote: Skeletons also lay in the chamber, prompting the party to consider removing their weapons as a precaution against animation
subject: Skeletons

fact: Glabbagool suggests he scout the room because oozes cannot go through him.
source_quote: the party accepted Glabbagool’s suggestion that he scout. “Well, you know, the oozes can’t go through me,” he reasoned
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Thorin tells Glabbagool they would sing his praises at the tavern once they get out of the Underdark.
source_quote: Thorin told him, “We would sing your praises at the tavern once we get out of the Underdark,”
subject: Thorin

fact: Glabbagool enters the fountain room to inspect it.
source_quote: Glabbagool entered and asked what he should inspect
subject: Glabbagool

fact: When Glabbagool touches one of the formless sculptures, it materializes into a gray ooze.
source_quote: When he touched one of the formless sculptures, it materialized into a gray ooze
subject: First Sculpture Activation

fact: Glabbagool complains about the sculpture transforming, saying “Well, that’s rude.”
source_quote: “Well, that’s rude,” he complained
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Zalthir rushed in and punched the gray ooze apart.
source_quote: Zalthir rushed in and punched the ooze apart
subject: First Ooze Destroyed

fact: The party chose to activate the remaining sculptures one at a time while Zalthir destroyed each resulting creature.
source_quote: The party then chose the cautious approach of activating the remaining sculptures one at a time. Zalthir rapidly destroyed each creature as it appeared
subject: Subsequent Sculptures Activated

fact: Gray oozes have extremely low armor class, making the darkness advantage question largely irrelevant.
source_quote: Darkness would have granted Zalthir an advantage if the oozes lacked blindsight, but their extremely low armor class makes the question largely irrelevant
subject: Gray Oozes

fact: Glabbagool methodically absorbed the debris from the destroyed oozes until the floor was perfectly clean.
source_quote: while Glabbagool methodically absorbed the debris until the floor was perfectly clean
subject: Debris Cleaned

fact: Glabbagool reports that the absorbed remains were “not very tasty.”
source_quote: He reports that the remains were “not very tasty.”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool searched the fountain and discovered a hidden cache of treasure.
source_quote: Glabbagool next searched the fountain and discovered a hidden cache of treasure
subject: Treasure Discovery

fact: The hidden cache contained 112 silver pieces.
source_quote: discovered a hidden cache of treasure: 112 silver pieces
subject: 112 Silver Pieces

fact: The hidden cache contained three gold pieces.
source_quote: three gold pieces
subject: 3 Gold Pieces

fact: The hidden cache contained a drow dagger.
source_quote: a drow dagger
subject: Drow Dagger

fact: The hidden cache contained a vial of oil of slipperiness.
source_quote: and a vial of oil of slipperiness
subject: Vial of Oil of Slipperiness

fact: Glabbagool absorbed the treasure cache he discovered.
source_quote: Unfortunately, he absorbed all of it
subject: Treasure Absorbed

fact: The party concluded they would have to wait several days for the valuables to pass through Glabbagool.
source_quote: The party concluded that they would have to wait several days for the valuables to pass through him
subject: Treasure Retrieval

fact: The party jokingly compares Glabbagool to a cube of holding or a convenience-store time safe.
source_quote: joking that Glabbagool had become “a cube of holding” or a convenience-store time safe
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The party retraced its path and chose the eastern route rather than investigating the remaining western passages.
source_quote: the party retraced its path and chooses the eastern route
subject: Route Selection

fact: The remaining western passages were not investigated.
source_quote: Rather than investigate the remaining western passages
subject: Western Passages
